documents.title: 日露和親条約批准書 — обмен ратификациями Симодского трактата
documents.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan / Historiographical Institute, University of Tokyo
documents.notes: Japanese MFA archival exhibition identifies and illustrates the treaty ratification instrument and explicitly states that the instruments of ratification were exchanged on 7 December 1856.

documents.title: Article 2 of the 1855 Treaty of Commerce, Navigation and Delimitation between Japan and Russia
documents.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan / Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
documents.publicationCitation: Joint Compendium of Documents on the History of Territorial Issue between Japan and Russia, jointly prepared by the Ministries of Foreign Affairs of Japan and the Russian Federation, 2001.
documents.notes: Article 2 states that the border passes between Etorofu/Iturup and Uruppu/Urup; Etorofu belongs to Japan, Urup and the Kurils north of it to Russia; Karafuto/Sakhalin remains unpartitioned between Japan and Russia.
